title: release-engineering-meeting-notes-2026-08-25
body:
Release Engineering Sync - 2026-08-25
Time: 10:00 - 10:45 PT
Owner: Samira Patel
Attendees: Ethan B., Marta N., Noah K., Priya R., Liam C., Marco D. (ops), Sarah L. (SRE)

Agenda:
- Quick status on active release trains (2026.08.1/2/3)
- Hotfix status and rollback plan for RL-2345
- Changelog highlights for 2026.08.3 GA
- Canary metrics and thresholds
- Action items / blockers

Notes:
1) Release trains
- 2026.08.1: Stable, fully rolled out last week. No regressions reported in telemetry. Marking closed in pipeline after final smoke tests. (QA sign-off: PR 1762)
- 2026.08.2: Minor patch window next Tue for dependency bump (protobuf). Targeted customers on Dedicated flagged for low-impact maintenance window 2026-08-31 02:00-05:00 UTC. Engineering contact: Noah K.
- 2026.08.3 (current train): Candidate build passed internal e2e and perf. Canary scheduled to start 2026-08-26 14:00 PT with 1% traffic. Key change: improved KV-cache eviction heuristics + batching improvements (serving-runtime PR #1789).
  - Known risk: slight latency variance at long-sequence workloads; SRE to monitor p99 across Model X and Model Y.
  - Canary thresholds: p99 < 350ms, error rate < 0.2% above baseline, token throughput drop < 5%. If thresholds breached within first 2 hours, automatic rollback to 2026.08.2 policy.

2) Hotfixes
- RL-2345 (hotfix): Root cause: regression in request routing introduced by RL-2344 that caused occasional KV cache misindexing for concurrent requests.
  - Hotfix patch: RL-2345 applied and tested in staging (PR 1795). Deployed to Canary cluster at 2026-08-25 09:00 PT. Initial results: error events reduced by ~98% in staging.
  - Production deployment: paused earlier today due to a rollback on a dependent config change (see linked config RL-CONF-88). Ops reverted the config; new rollout plan set for 2026-08-26 03:00 PT targeting surge capacity nodes only.
  - Rollback plan: immediate feature-flag flip and traffic re-route to previous model variant. SRE runbook updated: confluence page 'RL Hotfix Runbook' linked in artifacts.

3) Changelog highlights for 2026.08.3 (to be included in release notes)
- Improvements: KV cache eviction tuning, continuous batching speedups (~7% median token throughput), telemetry tagging for per-tenant slow-paths.
- Bug fixes: remote config parsing fix, upstream protobuf compatibility, fix for rare OOM in quantized path.
- Deprecations: legacy /v1/stream endpoint will be deprecated in 2026-10-01 (announce to customers next week).

4) Canary metrics / Observability
- Dashboards to watch: release-train/2026.08.3/canary-overview, serving/latency-by-model, cost/token-by-route.
- SLOs: latency SLOs and budget checks added to rollout job. Automation will pause rollout when cost-per-token increases >15% and not matched by >5% throughput improvement.
- Observed after staging run: small increase in 95th percentile latency for Model Y when sequence_length > 1024. Investigation: might be kernel selection path for quantized ops. Action: send perf trace to R&D (A. Chen) and schedule deep-dive.

5) Blockers
- Dependent config RL-CONF-88 caused unexpected behavior in node selection for Dedicated pools. Blocker owner: Marco D. Needs final signoff from infra by 2026-08-25 EOD. If not resolved, rollout window will be moved to 2026-08-27.
- QA needs additional end-to-end validation for enterprise tenant A (high token volumes). ETA for tests: 2026-08-26 noon.

6) Decisions made
- Proceed with canary for 2026.08.3 on 2026-08-26 14:00 PT limited to 1% traffic and surge-capacity nodes.
- Postpone full rollout until canary completes 24h with stable metrics.
- Defer /v1/stream deprecation announcement until legal reviews customer messaging.

7) Action items
- Marco D.: finalize RL-CONF-88 revert and confirm infra signoff (due 2026-08-25 EOD).
- Noah K.: run Dedicated maintenance window plan and notify customers (due 2026-08-27).
- Ethan B.: update release notes draft with changelog bullets and PR links (due 2026-08-25 EOD) -> PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1801
- Marta N.: run extended perf suite on Model Y long-seq (sequence_length 1024-2048) and upload traces (due 2026-08-26 12:00).
- Priya R.: prepare customer-facing note for enterprise tenants impacted by the protobuf bump (due 2026-08-26).
- Samira P.: coordinate post-canary review and schedule rollback drill (due 2026-08-27).

8) Parking lot / TODOs
- Add automated rollback rehearsal to release pipeline (tracked RL-2402).
- Revisit canary thresholds after next two trains to reduce false positives.
- Follow up on telemetry tagging cleanup (owner: Data Infra).

Next meeting: 2026-09-01 10:00 PT (weekly cadence)

Minutes recorded by: Samira Patel
